title: End-to-end benchmarking: FP8/INT8 profile stability across dynamic batching & KV-cache reuse for long-horizon workloads
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Objective: Validate that FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles and the new calibration workflow maintain accuracy and meet latency SLOs across realistic production patterns: dynamic/bursty batch sizing, KV-cache reuse across long context (>8k tokens), and mixed-request tail behavior. We need an end-to-end runbook that exercises: 1) calibration artifact generation (per-layer scale tables), 2) model variant construction (fp8/int8 with per-channel and per-tensor options), 3) runtime scheduling under dynamic batching and KV-cache hits/misses, and 4) automated accuracy and regression gating versus FP16 baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Defined run matrix that covers batch sizes: [1,2,4,8,16] and interleaved burst traces representing realistic PLG traffic
Calibration artifacts reproducible; artifacts for FP8 and INT8 stored in s3://redwood-quant/artifacts/ENG-35799 with SHA manifest
Throughput and p50/p95/p99 latency measured for each cell; all p95 tail latencies within 1.5x of FP16 baseline for target profile or documented fallbacks enabled
Accuracy measured on evaluation set (long-horizon text completion + specialized prompts) with automated diff against FP16; any regression >0.6% absolute token-accuracy or >1.0 BLEU-equivalent flagged
Runbook and scripts checked in under git: infra/bench/eng/eng-35799 with CI job that can re-run representative cells
Dashboard tile created in Console with per-profile breakdown and comparison to baseline (throughput, latency, accuracy).
tasks: Design run matrix and produce synthetic+prod-like traces (owner: Miguel)
Implement calibration orchestration job that accepts seed dataset and outputs profile tarball (owner: Priya Nair)
Build bench harness to replay traces with KV cache warm/cold cycles and dynamic batch policy (owner: Noah Lee)
Integrate accuracy eval pipeline: token-level metrics, BLEU-like summarization, and hallucination heuristics (owner: Lina Chen)
Provision dedicated small cluster (2 p4d nodes) for isolated runs and schedule longer sweep on shared infra (owner: infra oncall)
Collect results, analyze trade-offs, and create recommendation (quant profile defaults / fallback rules) (owner: Miguel)
Create dashboard and link artifacts + add to release notes (owner: product-observability)
Document runbook and postmortem template for future regressions (owner: Aisha)
run_matrix: Model variants: baseline-FP16, FP8-per-channel, FP8-per-tensor, INT8 per-channel symmetric, INT8 per-tensor asymmetric
Batch sizes: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16; with a secondary test of queued micro-batches (dynamic batching threshold 8)
KV-cache patterns: cold start (no cache), steady reuse (cache hit >90%), intermittent flushes (cache hit spikes/drops)
Traffic shapes: steady QPS, diurnal burst, and PLG-style random bursts generated from sampled prod traces
data_and_artifacts: Eval corpus: s3://datasets/evals/long-horizon-eval-v2/ (contains curated completion tasks and hallucination probes)
metrics_to_capture: Latency distribution: p50, p90, p95, p99, max
Scheduling overhead: batching latency contribution, queue wait time
KV-cache hit ratio and correlation with tail latency
Accuracy deltas vs FP16: token-accuracy, topk perplexity, BLEU-like summary for completions
Regression flags and per-layer sensitivity (summary numbers in artifact manifest)
initial_risks_and_mitigation: Risk: INT8 per-tensor may produce non-deterministic regressions for some layers -> Mitigation: add per-layer fallback to FP16 for layers exceeding calibration variance threshold
Risk: Bursty dynamic batching could amplify tail latency -> Mitigation: test both instant dispatch policy and max-wait batching policy; propose default conservative policy for FP8/INT8
Risk: Calibration dataset not representative -> Mitigation: combine prod-sampled traces with synthetic long-horizon sequences and rerun calibration with stratified sampling
Risk: Compute contention on shared infra -> Mitigation: reserve a small dedicated cluster for primary passes and run large sweeps overnight
deliverables: Calibration artifact set (tarballs + manifest) for all tested variants
Benchmark report: CSVs, plots, and recommendations (latency/throughput/accuracy trade-off table)
Runbook: step-by-step to reproduce and re-run failing cells
Console dashboard tile comparing profiles against FP16 baseline
Suggested default quant profile and rollback rules for runtime (PR to runtime-config)
Follow-up tickets for any per-layer fallback logic and autoscaling policy changes

comments: 2026-02-10 Aisha Kumar: Ticket created after spike. Initial scope includes both FP8 and INT8; proposing dynamic batching matrix to reflect PLG traffic. Assigning Miguel as lead.

2026-02-12 Miguel Santos: Drafted run matrix and synthetic trace generator. Uploaded initial trace sample to s3 and pushed trace generator to feature branch. Waiting on infra reservation for isolated runs.

2026-02-16 Priya Nair: Calibration orchestration prototype generates per-layer scale tables; observed higher variance for attention projection layers on INT8 per-tensor—logging artifacts to s3 with hash.

2026-02-18 Noah Lee: Bench harness updated to simulate KV-cache warm/cold cycles. Added instrumentation for queue wait time. First small-scale runs show FP8 throughput gains but p95 tail drift on bursty trace.

2026-02-22 Miguel Santos: Performed full sweep on dedicated cluster (2 p4d). Summary: FP8-per-channel meets throughput goals; INT8 shows accuracy regressions on ~3% of eval set for some prompt types—documenting layers for fallbacks. Drafting recommendations.

2026-02-25 Lina Chen: Accuracy pipeline shows average token-accuracy delta: FP8-per-channel -0.2% vs FP16; INT8-per-tensor -0.9% with concentrated regressions in numerical-table prompts. Added hallucination probe results to artifacts.

2026-02-27 Miguel Santos: Proposed default: enable FP8-per-channel by default for long-horizon profiles with INT8-per-channel behind opt-in flag + auto-fallback to FP16 for identified layers. Creating PR to runtime-config.
2026-03-01 Aisha Kumar: Updated ticket with dashboard link and checklist. Next: finalize runbook, add CI job to re-run flagged cells on regression alerts, and schedule review with runtime team.
notes: This ticket is exploratory and intended to produce an operational recommendation rather than a final product. Any thresholds chosen will be validated by a second independent run and migration plan will include canarying for Dedicated customers.
